title: Navbar: Navbar with title only (daisyUI)
notes:
Navbar is used to show a navigation bar on the top of the page.

Needs daisyUI installed (npm i -D daisyui, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS).

Original file: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui/blob/master/packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/navbar/+page.md
